reason: I'd sign up for the free plan at most, and probably not even that until I know what it does to my page speed. I run a real store, and a chat widget that slows things down or clashes with my theme costs me more than $29 ever would.
objection: Will it slow down my site or clash with my design? And will the AI make stuff up to my customers or mess with checkout? Mascots sound cute, but I need proof it won't hurt my conversion rate.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a live Shopify store using it with a real page-speed score, plus proof it measurably lifted sales or cut support tickets. I'd also need to hit the 50-conversation limit on the free plan first.
